trigger: Ruling #41 A2 (a one-shot wake-up at the next wall-time edge) let a stale alert set read current for hours after a system sleep or a clock change while offline (DECISIONS #43).
lesson: A deadline computed once from wall time and slept on a monotonic/uptime clock drifts whenever the two diverge (sleep, NTP, manual clock change).
how_to_apply: For anything that must change state at a wall-clock moment, cap each sleep (e.g. ≤60 s while visible), re-evaluate on NSSystemClockDidChange, and test with independent wall and monotonic advances.
